newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-BACKLEY GETS HATE MAIL AFTER CRITICISING GREEKS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BACKLEY GETS HATE MAIL AFTER CRITICISING GREEKS.

text.p: Briton Steve Backley, the men's world javelin silver medallist, received hate mail and a box of women's lingerie on Thursday following comments about a Greek rival.
"I'm glad I stuffed the Greek," Backley said after pushing the Greek thrower Kostas Gatzioudis into the bronze medal position with his last throw.
Local media translated his comments into much stronger language which lead to this morning's deliveries by outraged Greeks.
One letter read, "Go home Backley. You will not be missed in the least."
The sender of the box of lingerie suggested he contest the women's event in future.
Backley held a news conference with the Greek media on Thursday evening to explain the context of his comments but said he would not rephrase them.
